title: kate-core: keep a quote plain after an apostrophe
summary: A quote typed after an apostrophe stays plain. U+2019 and the ASCII apostrophe both count. The test goes in the existing pair tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: pair.rs is a private module of fanout.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Change only is_ascii_word. Keep the function name. The body is one expression: ch.is_alphanumeric() || ch == '_' || ch == '\'' || ch == '\u{2019}'. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch plan_pair, quote_stays_plain, odd_backslashes_before, is_type_over, is_opener, is_closer, is_quote, closer_for, one_scalar, char_before, or char_at. Update the doc comment on plan_pair. The old sentence says a quote after an ASCII letter, digit, or underscore stays plain. The new sentence says a quote after a letter, a digit, an underscore, or an apostrophe stays plain. You may update that comment. The existing tests a_quote_after_an_accented_letter_stays_plain, a_quote_after_a_backslash_stays_plain, and an_even_backslash_run_wraps_a_quote stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test a_quote_after_a_curly_apostrophe_stays_plain uses TextBuffer::from_str of don then U+2019 and a caret at Offset(4). plan_pair of a double quote returns Plain. The buffer don then an ASCII apostrophe and a caret at Offset(4) also returns Plain. The buffer a and a caret at Offset(1) stays Plain. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: fanout::pair::tests::a_quote_after_a_curly_apostrophe_stays_plain
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A quote after U+2019 returns Wrap. After the change it returns Plain. A quote after an ASCII apostrophe also returns Plain. A quote after the letter a stays Plain.
